Rendering in hyper-realistic quality

Every still and the tour video can be re-rendered with the hyper preset: 1024 samples per pixel, 14 light bounces with caustics, depth of field and motion blur, 1.3× resolution, OptiX denoising. On the render machine:

# all views
planviz render veronica-v2 --quality hyper
# one view, taken from the viewer's "Copy command" button
planviz render veronica-v2 --quality hyper --view "x,y,z;tx,ty,tz;lens"
# the tour video
planviz tour veronica-v2 --quality hyper

Notes

  • From the drawing: all wall footprints (structural hatch plus the 2 cm finish layer the dimensions reference), every door and window position and width, sill heights where noted on the plan (uk=+28, uk=+105), the balcony and its railing line, the louvered service balcony, and the furniture and fixtures where the designer placed them.
  • Assumed: 2.75 m clear ceiling height; door heights from the block names; the safe-room window at sill 100 and 100 cm high; a 15 cm curb with glass railing on the balcony; materials per the designer's brief (herringbone parquet, modern rustic, pastel children's room).
  • Revision 2 (drawing להדמיה 2): TV-wall window removed and walled up; kitchen display cabinet removed and the cabinet run extended 20 cm into its place; corridor wardrobe shortened to 235 cm with a vanity and mirror beside it; safe-room desk moved under the window as a two-seat workstation.
  • Revision 2b: coffee machine and water bar station in a counter niche at the north end of the tall-cabinet run; parquet changed to a lighter oak.
  • Design note: the safe-room door opens straight onto the back of the built-in closet that runs the full west wall; the tour cuts into the room instead of walking in.
